report.summary: The diwali_sip_offer push campaign sent at 13:30 triggered a massive traffic surge that overwhelmed orders-service and mobile-bff, causing executor queue exhaustion, high error rates, and hitting max replica limits.

supporting.note: Push campaign sent to 2.1M users at 13:30 with deep link orders/new-sip.
RPS anomaly started at 13:31, increasing request rate significantly.
RPS anomaly started at 13:31, mirroring the traffic surge.
Error rate spiked starting at 13:32 up to 15.85%.
RejectedExecutionException: order-executor queue full starting at 13:32.
Past incident with identical symptoms caused by traffic overload and low replica max.
market-data-service v2.12.0 deployed shortly before the incident.

contradicting.note: Market data service error rate remained completely flat and normal.

facts.text: Push campaign 'diwali_sip_offer' was sent to 2.1M users at 2026-10-10T13:30:00+00:00.
orders-service and mobile-bff request rates surged starting at 2026-10-10T13:31:00+00:00.
orders-service and mobile-bff error rates spiked starting at 2026-10-10T13:32:00+00:00.
orders-service logged RejectedExecutionException due to full order-executor queue starting at 13:32:04.

assumptions: The push campaign deep link directed users to initiate SIP orders, heavily concentrating traffic onto orders-service.
evidence_gaps: metrics query for orders-service initially timed out before succeeding on retry
orders-service log query shards experienced partial timeouts, leading to incomplete log counts

timeline.event: Push campaign diwali_sip_offer sent to 2.1M users
orders-service and mobile-bff request rates surge anomaly starts
orders-service and mobile-bff error rate anomaly starts

recommended_actions.action: Coordinate with growth team to stagger or temporarily pause massive push campaigns
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly halts the incoming traffic surge causing resource exhaustion.

recommended_actions.action: Increase maximum replica limits for orders-service and mobile-bff beyond 6 pods
recommended_actions.rationale: Allows services to scale up and absorb higher traffic volumes.

recommended_actions.action: Expand order-executor thread pool capacity and queue size in orders-service
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents RejectedExecutionException under high concurrent load.

recommended_actions.action: Establish communication workflows between marketing and SRE prior to launching large campaigns
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures proactive capacity provisioning for major product campaigns.
